transcript.statement: I assert that my safety requirements (SAF-01 to SAF-07) are critical to ensuring the autonomous system's reliability and hazard mitigation. The requirement for a Minimal Risk Maneuver (SAF-02) is vital to safely handle critical failures. Continuous monitoring of ODD (SAF-03), minimizing jerk (SAF-04), satisfying curvature constraints (SAF-05), and using iterative quadratic programming (SAF-06) further enhance safety. I see conflicts with EfficiencyAgent prioritizing smoothness (EFF-07), which could undermine safety during emergencies.

requirements.text: The system shall implement a multi-layer safety architecture including passive, active, and functional safety mechanisms.
The system shall execute a Minimal Risk Maneuver within 5 seconds upon detecting critical system failures to ensure safety.
The system shall continuously monitor Operational Design Domain compliance and issue timely human takeover requests.
The system shall allow relaxation of smoothness constraints during emergencies with a jerk limit of 0.75 m/s³ while monitoring energy consumption.
The system shall satisfy curvature constraints to prevent rollover during maneuvers.
The system shall utilize iterative quadratic programming to handle non-convex obstacle constraints reliably.
The system shall implement end-to-end data encryption for all user data transmitted.
The system shall enforce role-based access control to protect user permissions.
The system shall log all access and modifications to critical data for auditability.
The system shall implement a multi-layer safety architecture that guarantees active monitoring.
The system shall document all safety and compliance-related decisions for accountability.
The system shall ensure compliance with Apollo Pilot Safety Report and EM Motion Planner specifications.
The system shall provide timely HMI warnings to request human takeover when ODD compliance is at risk.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during operation by optimizing path and speed profiles.
The system shall implement lifecycle assessments for all components to ensure sustainability.
